findings.type: mechanism omission, not a violation of the frozen adaptation protocol
findings.title: ScopeEdit scope-control algorithm is absent
findings.evidence: Current run.py:275-288 uses fixed source/FIT/GFIT CE and global Base KL; no modality evidence gate, local/shared orthogonal spaces or branch-wise recursive preconditioners. Author lora_layers.py:1063-1128,1234-1269 implements gate and distinct updates.
findings.consequence: Trained anchors constrain sampled behavior, but do not implement evidence-dependent propagation boundaries.
findings.minimum_action: Describe this as scope-supervised direct-W editing. A faithful scope mechanism requires a separate frozen design and parity validation; do not modify this completed round.

findings.title: LOKI author implementation differs from its algorithm sketch and from this prototype
findings.evidence: Author loki_main.py:396 uses Adam;525-538 projects cumulative displacement from edit-boundary weights;549-556 bounds cumulative Frobenius displacement by eps times boundary-weight norm. Current purew_math.py:25-27 uses projected SGD with per-step cap0.05; no cumulative radius. Author null_dim1000 versus this full right nullspace10240; dynamic HSIC selection and HSIC loss omitted.
findings.consequence: Cannot attribute the behavior to the original LOKI optimizer or trust constraint. Norm0.05 in this protocol is an absolute per-step bound, not a5percent cumulative weight-relative bound.
findings.minimum_action: State all differences explicitly; if comparing original LOKI later, preserve its parameterization/optimizer/constraint and use a separately registered comparison.

findings.type: partial principle transfer and missing author-code verification
findings.title: DOW-KE final-forward principle retained; preservation parameterization absent
findings.evidence: Paper equations9-10 use multiple layers, Delta=P_out A B with fixed edit-key/preservation basis and subject-position backward routing. This prototype has one dense W, a weight-derived right projector and response-prefix KL. Author code not located.
findings.consequence: End-to-end CE alone does not implement DOW-KE input/output protection or cross-layer coupling. Post-backward projection itself is consistent with fixed-subspace plain SGD; it is not an observed closure bug.
findings.minimum_action: Label DOW-KE-inspired final-output objective only; do not claim author-code audit or full reproduction.

findings.title: Top-level controller is not stage-aware on reentry
findings.evidence: run.py:361-370 launches smoke/Base/train/eval unconditionally; base:154 emits every output and emit:87 rejects existing outputs; train:219 rejects completed candidate. Controller assertions375-376 do not distinguish failed/replayed work from committed formal work.
findings.consequence: A restart after Base completion stops at existing output instead of resuming remaining stages; replayed partial steps can invalidate exact cost-count assertions. No such formal training interruption is documented in this completed run.
findings.minimum_action: Gate stages by binding-validated completion receipts, skip completed Base consumers, dispatch only unfinished arms and separate spent attempts from committed updates; preserve old failures/costs.

findings.type: P2 historical diagnostic retention defect, future logging added after completion
findings.title: Per-step loss/gradient trace was retired with matrices
findings.evidence: Executed c5aa524 stored trace only in active/candidate matrices; controller later deleted all4 matrices. Latest run.py:319 adds a separate JSON write, the only algorithm-driver difference between c5aa524 and058f904.
findings.consequence: Cannot now reconstruct per-step KL, update magnitudes, accumulated displacement or actual FP32 projection residuals from full traces. Terminal receipts, periodic logs and generated outputs remain.
findings.minimum_action: Keep the new diagnostic logging for future runs; retain small summaries before cleanup. Do not rebuild weights or rerun the completed experiment to fill missing history.

DEV success is neither faithful three-paper reproduction nor independent clinical or SOTA evidence.

author_paper_code_differences.evidence: Paper Algorithm1 projects and clips gradients; author loki_main.py:396,525-556 uses Adam and projects/bounds cumulative displacement. Specify paper versus author-code reference before any faithful comparison.

Paper Eq20 defines gamma=sigmoid(beta(cos-tau))*support and Eq23 weights keys by sqrt(gamma). Author lora_layers.py:1111-1118 additionally splits gamma by modality norm and normalizes mixed q;1234-1269 sends gamma_self as write scale, while1001-1023 updates P with q without an explicit sqrt(scale). Static implementation is not a literal transcription; not claiming an author-method bug without a runtime derivation/parity test.
